provenance: Deterministic locally generated synthetic fixtures; no private documents. navigation removes the form from the legacy generator and adds supported direct/local/named/remote navigation. form retains controlled AcroForm. Neither fixture is real-world evidence.
limitations: Actual production handler code executed in a Node simulated React/URL harness; no browser/download claim
PDF.js inspection is independent parsing, not interactive selection or visual fidelity
Grayscale uses Node canvas and local worker/fonts; no actual browser/CDN test
qpdf uses installed local WASM; CDN loading NOT TESTED
Signatures, interactive forms, visual review and browser behavior NOT TESTED
Image operator counts do not prove pixel preservation; vector operator counts do not prove vector equivalence
Encryption salts and tool metadata timestamps can vary across repetitions; retained artifacts immutable
AcroForm page-copy rejection is expected UNSUPPORTED, not a preservation defect
